versions.changelog:
DeepSeek Harness one-click local deployment assistant, first public release.

- Provides a clear introduction to DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and its use cases.
- Guides users to obtain an API Key from the DeepSeek platform and explains secure configuration.
- Detects the user's operating system and automates Node.js installation, mirrors, and dsh installation accordingly.
- Real-time generates platform-specific desktop shortcuts to launch dsh web service and open http://localhost:3080.
- No bundled scripts; all commands and shortcuts are dynamically created by the agent during runtime.
